scenes.headline: taxi tricks to know
scenes.say: Getting a taxi from the airport? Here are three tricks to watch for.

scenes.headline: "The meter's broken"
scenes.say: One. The meter's broken. Agree the price before you get in, or use the official taxi rank, or a ride app.
scenes.caption: One. "The meter's broken." Agree the price before you get in, or use the official taxi rank or a ride app.

pills.text: or use the official rank or a ride app

scenes.headline: "Your hotel is closed"
scenes.say: Two. Your hotel is closed, so they'll take you somewhere better. Call your hotel yourself before you change plans.
scenes.caption: Two. "Your hotel is closed," so they'll take you somewhere better. Call your hotel yourself before you change plans.

scenes.headline: The scenic route
scenes.say: Three. The scenic route. Follow the trip on your own map, so you know you're going the right way.
